note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). Every `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'), including recitations without marks; it supersedes the earlier 1962 UBS wording and the self-rendered Old Testament. The sermon's text, Micah 6:6, turns on 'Wherewith shall I come…?': OWB's «… ምን ይዤ ልምጣ?» now carries it everywhere it is quoted or echoed. Allusions and the author's own paraphrases stay self_rendered.
